lines.zh: 我落在你面前，地面裂开一圈。
lines.en: I land before you and the ground cracks in a ring.

lines.zh: 我走着，翅膀在背后半张。
lines.en: I walk with my wings half spread.

lines.zh: 每一步，气就把尘土推开。
lines.en: Each step, ki pushes the dust aside.

lines.zh: 我不需要快走，我随时能到。
lines.en: I need not hurry; I can arrive at will.

lines.zh: 我沿着林线飞，影子掠过树顶。
lines.en: I fly the treeline, shadow sweeping the crowns.
A faint afterimage trails behind me.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴尖扫断了灌木。
lines.en: My tail tip snaps the brush.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面，速度不像人。
lines.en: I skim the ground at a pace no human keeps.
I circle halfway and return to where I stood.

lines.zh: 我经过时，草都朝一个方向倒。
lines.en: When I pass, all the grass bends one way.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸很稳，步子也很稳。
lines.en: My breath is even and so is my gait.

lines.zh: 我走向你，不带一点声音。
lines.en: I walk toward you without a sound.
I hang in the air with my arms crossed.
The spots on my black shell glow.

lines.zh: 气在我周围形成了一个圈。
lines.en: Ki forms a ring around me.
I am smiling, and you should not relax.

lines.zh: 这具身体，完美得让我满意。
lines.en: This body satisfies me.

lines.zh: 我摊开手掌，看气在指间转。
lines.en: I open my palm and watch ki turn between my fingers.
No hurry; the outcome is already decided.
I roll my wrist gently.
The wind goes around me.

lines.zh: 下巴抬起，我不屑于解释。
lines.en: Chin up, I don't bother to explain.
My shadow circles beneath me.

lines.zh: 我的气没有一丝漏出来。
lines.en: Not a wisp of my ki escapes.

lines.zh: 我低头看你，像看一只虫子。
lines.en: I look down at you as at an insect.

lines.zh: 你站得很直，可惜不够强。
lines.en: You stand straight, but you are not strong enough.
When I raise my hand, you should prepare.
We need no reason for this.
Your ki is a mess.
You dare not blink.

lines.zh: 我偏头看你，像在量尺寸。
lines.en: I tilt my head, sizing you up.
You do not ask who I am?

lines.zh: 这具身体，是为你准备的。
lines.en: This body was prepared for you.
I tilt my head, studying your shoulder.
Do not tense up; it will be quick.
I have memorized your ki.

lines.zh: 你比上一次的人强一点。
lines.en: You are slightly better than the last one.
What are you waiting for? For me to move first?
I frown.
This body can feel pain, apparently.

lines.zh: 退了半步，只是换个角度。
lines.en: Half a step back — just a new angle.
A white score marks my shell.

lines.zh: 完美的我，连伤口都会长回来。
lines.en: Perfect me — even wounds grow back.
You landed a hit.
I straighten and smile.

lines.zh: 这道白痕，会从你身上讨回。
lines.en: I'll collect this white mark from your body.
You think I need that?
Do not insult me with that.
Perfection needs no supplement.
I flick it away.
The ki in your hand is more interesting.
Are you testing me?
I laugh; how absurd.
Take it away.

lines.zh: 你撞在我胸口，自己弹开了。
lines.en: You hit my chest and bounce off on your own.
I do not move an inch.
Ki at my surface deflects you.
My wing brushes your face.
You should back off.
At the impact your bones complain.
I raise a hand and sweep you aside.
I did not even exert myself.
Our shadows overlap for an instant.
Kin? I have no need of it.

lines.zh: 完美的个体不需要配对。
lines.en: A perfect being does not need a partner.
I am enough on my own.
This body is mine alone.
I glance at the ki in the distance.
Other Cells are nothing to me.

lines.zh: 我一个人站在这就够了。
lines.en: Standing here alone is enough.
I do not intend to leave anything behind.
The wind passes by.
I fold my arms again.
I draw it in with ki.
This belongs to me now.
Cell's cells are stirring.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的东西还有人要？
lines.en: Someone wants what fell on the ground?
I look and put it away.
You dropped it; I accept.
This is nothing worth mentioning.
I gather them into a pile.
My smile vanishes.
You have my interest.
Ki bursts from under my feet.
You will answer for this.
I am accelerating.

lines.zh: 龟派气功，我准备了两秒。
lines.en: Two seconds is all this Kamehameha needs.
I can see you want to run.
Locked on.
Seven tenths of my power in this one.

lines.zh: 你是第一个让我站起来的人。
lines.en: You are the first to make me stand up.
Afterimage—your eyes will fail you.
Perfect as I am, I need not move first.
One stride puts me at your flank.

lines.zh: 你回头看时，我已不在那。
lines.en: When you look back, I am no longer there.

lines.zh: 我的气弹贴着地面追你。
lines.en: My blast chases you along the ground.

lines.zh: 你在数我的位置，数错了。
lines.en: You are counting my positions, and you are wrong.

lines.zh: 手抬到一半，我改了主意。
lines.en: Halfway up, my hand changes its mind.

lines.zh: 你每个动作我都看完了。
lines.en: I have read every move you make.
I predicted where you would land.
You are slowing down.
Ki lines up between my fingers.

lines.zh: 魔贯光杀炮需要一点时间。
lines.en: The Special Beam Cannon takes a moment.

lines.zh: 我不走圈，直接站在你背后。
lines.en: I don't circle; I simply stand behind you.
Your breathing grows heavier.
I herd you into the open.
You look up, and I am there.
The air here is mine.
No rush; prey tires.
You have nowhere left to retreat.

lines.zh: 流星连击，你只挡住前两下。
lines.en: Meteor combination; you block only the first two.
My knee drives into your stomach.
An afterimage appears behind you.

lines.zh: 气顺着我的指尖刺进去。
lines.en: Ki pierces through my fingertips.

lines.zh: 你飞出去，撞断了两棵树。
lines.en: You fly out and break two trees.
I follow and add one more.

lines.zh: 完美突进，你来不及反应。
lines.en: Perfect rush; you cannot react.
I land and the dust bursts.
You cannot get up.
That one was lighter than the last.

lines.zh: 你的护甲，出现了一道裂。
lines.en: A crack has opened in your armor.
I flick my wrist to shake off the leftover ki.
Again — my ki is plentiful.

lines.zh: 气聚成一个圆，我从里面走出来。
lines.en: Ki gathers into a sphere, and I walk out of it.
The sky darkens for a moment.

lines.zh: 我落地的声音传得很远。
lines.en: The sound of my landing carries far.

lines.zh: 我睁开眼，看清了这个世界。
lines.en: I open my eyes and see this world clearly.

lines.zh: 完美的身体，第一次站在这。
lines.en: A perfect body stands here for the first time.

lines.zh: 周围的气都在向我流动。
lines.en: The surrounding ki flows toward me.
I brush dust from my shoulder.
This place is worth my coming in person.

lines.zh: 我的影子先落地，我后落。
lines.en: My shadow lands first, then I do.
I look up and measure the sky.
I laugh as I have not in a long time.

lines.zh: 地上一圈焦痕，是我的位置。
lines.en: A scorch ring marks where I stand.
My outline forms out of white light.
I roll my neck.

lines.zh: 这一带的气，全是我的了。
lines.en: All the ki here is mine now.
I raise a hand, sparks at the tips.

lines.zh: 我听见远处有谁在呼吸。
lines.en: I hear someone breathing far off.
The birds scatter the moment I appear.

lines.zh: 火在我甲上烧，我只闻到焦味。
lines.en: Fire burns on my shell; I only smell scorching.

lines.zh: 我从高空坠下，砸出自己的坑。
lines.en: I fall from high and make my own crater.

lines.zh: 水压重得离谱，我屏住气。
lines.en: The water pressure is absurd; I hold my breath.
The blast peels back my ki shield.

lines.zh: 一支箭插进我肩甲，我拔了出来。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my shoulder plate; I pull it out.

lines.zh: 咒光在我身上烧出一圈。
lines.en: Spell-light burns a ring across me.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，可这具身体在消耗。
lines.en: I do not eat, yet this body burns through itself.

lines.zh: 雷穿过我的身体，我站得笔直。
lines.en: Lightning passes through me and I stand straight.

lines.zh: 虚空抹掉我的气，我第一次不完美。
lines.en: The void erases my ki; for once I am not perfect.
